newsitem.title: FRANCE: French agricultural revenues to increase in '96.
newsitem.headline: French agricultural revenues to increase in '96.

text.p: Agriculture Minister Philippe Vasseur said on Saturday French agricultural revenues would rise in 1996 but there would be differences according to sectors.
"I expect a new increase of agricultural revenues this year...positive figures," Vasseur told reporters at a seminar of leaders of his Union for French Democracy (UDF) party.

"But there will be big differences in figures according to sector," said Vasseur recalling that while agricultural revenues as a whole rose by 10.5 percent in 1995, fruit producers saw their revenues drop while other sectors saw rises of up to 33 percent.
"We won't see figures jumping as high as that but investment has resumed and the number of young farmers is on the increase," Vasseur added.

He said there was record wheat production but that the fruit and vegetable producers were doing poorly while the cattle sector, hit by fears of mad cow disease, was suffering "a veritable catastrophe."
